tours.name: Compute, Check and Confirm a Payslip

name_i18n.en_US: Compute, Check and Confirm a Payslip

tours.description: Learn how to open an employee's payslip, check the worked days it is based on, recompute it, read the salary computation line by line, and confirm it.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to open an employee's payslip, check the worked days it is based on, recompute it, read the salary computation line by line, and confirm it.

steps.title: Open Payroll
steps.description: Individual payslips are reviewed and confirmed in the Payroll app.

description_i18n.en_US: Individual payslips are reviewed and confirmed in the Payroll app.

steps.title: Payslips menu
steps.description: The Payslips menu lists the payslips of all employees and the batches they belong to.

description_i18n.en_US: The Payslips menu lists the payslips of all employees and the batches they belong to.

steps.title: All Payslips
steps.description: This list shows every payslip with the employee, period and net amount. Use the search bar to find a particular employee or period.

description_i18n.en_US: This list shows every payslip with the employee, period and net amount. Use the search bar to find a particular employee or period.

steps.title: Open a batch
steps.content: Click a batch name to show its payslips.

content_i18n.en_US: Click a batch name to show its payslips.

steps.description: Payslips are grouped by batch. Click a batch to expand it and see the payslip of each employee; the figure beside it is the total for the batch.

description_i18n.en_US: Payslips are grouped by batch. Click a batch to expand it and see the payslip of each employee; the figure beside it is the total for the batch.

steps.title: Open a payslip
steps.content: Click a payslip to open it.

content_i18n.en_US: Click a payslip to open it.

steps.description: Opening a payslip shows the employee, the period, the contract and the salary structure it was computed with.

description_i18n.en_US: Opening a payslip shows the employee, the period, the contract and the salary structure it was computed with.

steps.title: Worked days and inputs
steps.content: Click the Worked Days & Inputs tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the Worked Days & Inputs tab.

steps.description: This tab shows the days and hours the pay is based on, such as normal working days and unpaid leave, plus any extra inputs. Check it first: a wrong number here gives a wrong payslip.

description_i18n.en_US: This tab shows the days and hours the pay is based on, such as normal working days and unpaid leave, plus any extra inputs. Check it first: a wrong number here gives a wrong payslip.

steps.title: Compute Sheet
steps.content: Click Compute Sheet to recalculate the payslip.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Compute Sheet to recalculate the payslip.

steps.description: Compute Sheet recalculates every line from the contract, the worked days and the inputs. Click it again whenever you change something that affects the pay.

description_i18n.en_US: Compute Sheet recalculates every line from the contract, the worked days and the inputs. Click it again whenever you change something that affects the pay.

steps.title: Salary Computation tab
steps.description: This tab lists each salary rule that was applied, from the basic salary to the net amount the employee receives.

description_i18n.en_US: This tab lists each salary rule that was applied, from the basic salary to the net amount the employee receives.

steps.title: Read the lines
steps.content: Look at the Total column, then click it to continue.

content_i18n.en_US: Look at the Total column, then click it to continue.

steps.description: Each line shows a rule, its category and its amount. Allowances add to the pay and deductions reduce it, ending with the Net Salary line.

description_i18n.en_US: Each line shows a rule, its category and its amount. Allowances add to the pay and deductions reduce it, ending with the Net Salary line.

steps.title: Confirm the payslip
steps.content: Click Create Draft Entry to confirm the payslip.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Create Draft Entry to confirm the payslip.

steps.description: Once the figures are correct, confirm the payslip. Odoo asks you to confirm because a payslip that is done can no longer be edited.

description_i18n.en_US: Once the figures are correct, confirm the payslip. Odoo asks you to confirm because a payslip that is done can no longer be edited.

steps.title: Confirm in the window
steps.description: Ok marks the payslip as Done. It is now locked and ready to be paid and posted to accounting.

description_i18n.en_US: Ok marks the payslip as Done. It is now locked and ready to be paid and posted to accounting.
